entries.title: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.excerpt: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began t...
entries.hadithText: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said." .
entries.englishText: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said: When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said." .
entries.arabicText: وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ أغمي على عبد الله بن رواحة رضي الله عنه فجعلت أخته تبكي، وتقول‏:‏ واجبلاه، وا كذا وا كذا‏:‏ تعدد عليه فقال حين أفاق‏:‏ ما قلت شيئًا ألا قيل لي ‏:‏أنت كذلك‏؟‏‏!‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ اشتكى سعد بن عبادة رضي الله عنه شكوى فأتاه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعوده مع عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فلما دخل عليه، وجده في غشية فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏أقضي‏؟‏‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ لا يا رسول الله فبكى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فلما رأى القوم بكاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بكوا، قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ألا تسمعون‏؟‏ إن الله لا يُعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن يعذب بهذا‏"‏ وأشار إلى لسانه ‏"‏أو يرحم‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will b...
entries.hadithText: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof)." .
entries.englishText: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي مالك الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏النائحة إذا لم تتب قبل موتها تقام يوم القيامة وعليها سربال من قطران، ودرع من جرب‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said

entries.title: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain amo...
entries.hadithText: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' " .
entries.englishText: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' " .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏ما من ميت يموت، فيقوم باكيهم، فيقول‏:‏ واجبلاه، وأسيداه، أو نحو ذلك إلا وكل به ملكان يلهزانه‏:‏ أهكذا كنت‏؟‏‏!‏‏" ‏‏.‏ رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏.‏ «اللَّهْزُ»: الدَّفْعُ بِجُمْعِ اليَدِ فِي الصَّدْرِ.
entries.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in th...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏اثنان في الناس هما بهم كفر‏:‏ الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Some people
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon thi...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it." . The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Some people asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about soothsayers. He (ﷺ) said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it." . The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."
entries.arabicText: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أناس عن الكهان، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏ليسوا بشيء‏"‏ فقالوا‏:‏ يا رسول الله إنهم يحدثونا أحيانًا بشيء، فيكون حقًا‏؟‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏تلك الكلمة من الحق يخطفها الجني‏.‏ فيقرها في أذن وليه، فيخلطون معها مائة كذبة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية للبخاري عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أنها سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الملائكة تنزل في العَنان -وهو السحاب-‏.‏ فتذكر الأمر قضي في السماء، فيسترق الشيطان السمع، فيسمعه، فيوحيه إلى الكهان، فيكذبون معها مائة كذبة من عند أنفسهم‏"‏‏ قَولُهُ: «فَيَقُرُّهَا» هو بفتح الياء وضم القاف والراء، أي: يُلْقِيها، «والعَنانِ» بفتح العين.

entries.excerpt: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about ma...
entries.hadithText: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days." .
entries.englishText: Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days." .
entries.arabicText: وعن قبيصة بنت أبي عبيد، عن بعض أزواج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، ورضي الله عنها، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏من أتي عرافًا فسأله عن شيء، فصدقه، لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين يومًا‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.title: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured...
entries.hadithText: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He (ﷺ) replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct." .
entries.englishText: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He (ﷺ) replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct." .
entries.arabicText: وعن معاوية بن الحكم رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قلت يا رسول الله إني حديث عهد بجاهلية، وقد جاء الله تعالى بالإسلام، وإن منا رجالا يأتون الكهان‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏فلا تأتهم‏"‏ قلت‏:‏ ومنا رجال يتطيرون‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ذلك شيء يجدونه في صدورهم، فلا يصدهم‏"‏ قلت‏:‏ ومنا رجال يخطون‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏كان نبي من الأنبياء يخط، فمن وافق خطه، فذاك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.hadithText: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer. .
entries.englishText: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي مسعود البدري رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏نهى عن ثمن الكلب، ومهر البغي وحُلوان الكاهن‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word." .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word." .
entries.arabicText: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة ويعجبني الفأل‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ وما الفأل‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏كلمة طيبة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة، وإن كان الشؤم في شيء ففي الدار والمرأة، والفرس‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.arabicText: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إن الذين يصنعون هذه الصور يعذبون يوم القيامة، يقال لهم‏:‏ أحيوا ما خلقتم‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curta...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that. .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that. .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لي بقرام فيه تماثيل فلما رآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، تلون وجهه، وقال‏:‏ ‏ "‏يا عائشة، أشد الناس عذابًا عن الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله‏" ‏ قالت‏:‏ فقطعناه، فجعلنا منه وسادة أو وسادتين‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ «القِرامُ» بكسرِ القاف هو: السِّتْرُ. «وَالسَّهْوَةُ» بفتح السينِ المهملة وهي: الصُّفَّةُ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ البَيْتِ، وقيلَ: هِيَ الطَّاقُ النَّافِذُ في الحائِطِ.

entries.title: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has ma...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell." Ibn 'Abbas said: If you have to do it, draw pictures of trees and other inanimate things. .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell." Ibn 'Abbas said: If you have to do it, draw pictures of trees and other inanimate things. .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏كل مصور في النار يجعل له بكل صورة صورها نفس فيعذبه في جهنم‏"‏ قال ابن عباس‏:‏ فإن كنت لابد فاعلا، فاصنع الشجر وما لا ورح فيه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.arabicText: وعنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏من صور في الدنيا، كُلف أن يَنفخ فيها الروح يوم القيامة وليس بنافخ‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley."' .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley."' .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏قال الله تعالى‏:‏ ‏{‏ومن أظلم ممن ذهب يخلق كخلقي‏!‏ فليخلقوا ذرة أو ليخلقوا حبة، أو ليخلقوا شعيرة‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait." .
entries.hadithText: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait." .
entries.englishText: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي طلحة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا تدخل الملائكة بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Jibril
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and this grieved him very much. Wh...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ وعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جبريل أن يأتيه فراث عليه حتى اشتد على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فخرج فلقيه جبريل فشكا إليه، فقال‏:‏ إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏ ‏(‏‏(‏‏ "‏راث‏" ‏‏:‏ أبطأ، وهو بالثاء المثلثة‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel)
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture." .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Jibril (Gabriel) (ﷺ) made a promise with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture." .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ واعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جبريل عليه السلام في ساعة أن يأتيه، فجاءت تلك الساعة ولم يأته‏!‏ قالت‏:‏ وكان بيده عصًا، فطرحها من يده وهو يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏ما يخلف الله وعده ولا رسله‏"‏ ثم التفت، فإذا جرو كلب تحت سريره‏.‏ فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏متى دخل هذا الكلب‏؟‏‏"‏ فقلت‏:‏ والله ما دريت به، فأمر به فأخرج، فجاءه جبريل عليه السلام‏:‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏وعدتني، فجلست لك ولم تأتني‏"‏ فقال‏:‏ منعني الكلب الذي كان في بيتك، إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May
entries.excerpt: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of A...
entries.hadithText: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled." .
entries.englishText: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي الهياج حيان بن حصين قال‏:‏ قال لي علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه‏:‏ ألا أبعثك على ما بعثني عليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏؟‏ أن لا تدع صورة إلا طمستها، ولا قبرًا مشرفًا إلا سويته‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunt...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards." .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏من اقتنى كلبًا إلا كلب صيد أو ماشية فإنه ينقص فإنه ينقص من أجره كل يوم قيراطان‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية‏:‏ ‏ ‏قيراط‏‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat e...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd." . In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd." . In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏من أمسك كلبًا فإنه ينقص كل يوم من عمله قيراط إلا كلب حرث أو ماشية‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏من اقتنى كلبًا ليس بكلب صيد، ولا ماشية ولا أرض، فإنه ينقص من أجره قيراطان كل يوم‏"‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا تصحب الملائكة رفقة كلب أو جرس‏" ‏‏.‏ ((رواه مسلم))

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan." .
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan." .
entries.arabicText: وعنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏الجرس مزامير الشيطان‏" ‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏

entries.title: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle...
entries.hadithText: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth." .
entries.englishText: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth." .
entries.arabicText: عن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏البصاق في المسجد خطيئة، وكفارتها دفنها‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ والمرادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ تُرَابًا أوْ رَمْلًا ونَحْوَهُ فَيُوَارِيهَا تَحْتَ تُرَابِهِ. قالَ أبُو المحاسِنِ الرُّويَانِي مِنْ أصحابِنا في كِتَابِهِ (البحر) وقِيلَ: المُرَادُ بِدَفْنِهَا إخْراجُهَا مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، أمَّا إِذَا كَانَ المَسْجِدُ مُبَلَّطًا أَوْ مُجَصَّصًا، فَدَلَكَهَا عَلَيْهِ بِمَدَاسِهِ أَوْ بِغَيْرِهِ كَمَا يَفْعَلُهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الجُهَّالِ، فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِدَفْنٍ، بَلْ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الخَطِيئَةِ وَتَكْثِيرٌ لِلقَذَرِ في المَسْجِدِ، وَعَلَى مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ أنْ يَمْسَحَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِثَوْبِهِ أَوْ بِيَدِهِ أَوْ غَيرِهِ أَوْ يَغْسِلَهُ.
entries.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off. .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off. .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رأى في جدار القبلة مخاطا أو بزاقا أو نخامة فحكه ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are mer...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated. .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إن هذه المساجد لا تصلح لشيء من البول ولا القذر، إنما هي لذكر الله تعالى، وقراءة القرآن‏" ‏ أو كما قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has los...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."
entries.arabicText: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏من سمع رجلا ينشد ضالة في المسجد فليقل‏:‏ لا ردها الله عليك، فإن المساجد لم تبنَ لهذا‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A man
entries.excerpt: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?"...
entries.hadithText: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.)." .
entries.englishText: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رجلا نشد في المسجد فقال‏:‏ من دعا إلى الجمل الأحمر، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا وجدت، إنما بنيت المساجد لم بنيت له‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May
entries.excerpt: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited (us) from buying and selling...
entries.hadithText: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it. .
entries.englishText: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it. .
entries.arabicText: وعن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن الشراء والبيع في المسجد، وأن تنشد فيه ضالة، أو ينشد فيه شعر‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏
entries.narrator: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Um...
entries.hadithText: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." .
entries.englishText: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن السائب بن زيد الصحابي رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ كنت في المسجد فحصبني رجل، فنظرت فإذا عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه فقال‏:‏ اذهب فائتني بهذين، فجئته بهما، فقال‏:‏ من أين أنتما‏؟‏ فقالا‏:‏ من أهل الطائف، فقال‏:‏ لو كنتما من أهل البلد، لأوجعتكما، ترفعان أصواتكما في مسجد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏!‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque." . The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques."
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque." . The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques."
entries.arabicText: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل من هذه الشجرة -يعني الثوم- فلا يقربن مسجدنا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏مساجدنا‏"‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us." .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏من أكل من هذه الشجرة، فلا يقربنا، ولا يصلين معنا‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques." . The narration...
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques." . The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten onion or garlic or leek should not approach our mosque, because the angels are also offended by the strong smells) that offend the children of Adam." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques." . The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten onion or garlic or leek should not approach our mosque, because the angels are also offended by the strong smells) that offend the children of Adam." .
entries.arabicText: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا فليعتزلنا، أو فليعتزل مسجدنا‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية لمسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏من أكل البصل، والثوم، الكراث، فلا يقربن مسجدنا، فإن الملائكة تتأذى مما يتأذى منه بنو آدم‏"‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased
entries.excerpt: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odo...
entries.hadithText: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out. .
entries.englishText: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer: "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out. .
entries.arabicText: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه خطب يوم الجمعة فقال في خطبته‏:‏ ثم إنكم أيها الناس تأكلون شجرتين ما أراهما إلا خبيثتين‏:‏ البصل، والثوم -لقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا وجد ريحهما من الرجل في المسجد أمر به، فأخرج إلى البقيع، فمن أكلهما، فليمتهما طبخًا‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him)
entries.excerpt: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') durin...
entries.hadithText: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer). .
entries.englishText: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer). .
entries.arabicText: عن معاذ بن أنس الجهني، رضي الله عنه، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن الحبوة يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب ‏(‏‏(‏رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقالا‏:‏ حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏
entries.narrator: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The
entries.excerpt: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month...
entries.hadithText: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice." .
entries.englishText: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice." .
entries.arabicText: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏من كان له ذبح يذبحه، فإذا أهل هلال ذي الحجة، فلا يأخذن من شعره ولا من أظفاره شيئًا حتى يضحي‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oat...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent." .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قال‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الله تعالى ينهاكم أن تحلفوا بآبائكم، فمن كان حالفًا، فليحلف بالله، أو ليصمت‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية في الصحيح ‏"‏فمن كان حالفًا فلا يحلف إلا بالله أو ليسكت‏"‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, f...
entries.hadithText: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers." .
entries.englishText: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers." .
entries.arabicText: وعن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة، رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لا تحلفوا بالطواغي، ولا بآبائكم‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ ‏"‏الطواغي‏"‏‏:‏ جمع طاغية، وهي الأصنام، ومنه الحديث‏:‏ ‏"‏هذه طاغية دوس‏"‏‏:‏ أي‏:‏ صنمهم ومعبودهم، وروي في غير مسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏بالطواغيت‏"‏ جمع طاغوت، وهو الشيطان والصنم‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us." .
entries.hadithText: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us." .
entries.englishText: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us." .
entries.arabicText: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏من حلف بالأمانة، فليس منا‏" ‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
entries.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنه سمع رجلا يقول‏:‏ لا والكعبة، قال ابن عمر‏:‏ لا تحلف بغير الله، فإني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏من حلف بغير الله، فقد كفر أو أشرك‏"‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏ رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏ وفسر بعض العلماء قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏كفر أو أشرك‏"‏ على التغليظ، كما روي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏الرياء شرك‏"‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He...
entries.hadithText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited: "Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77) .
entries.englishText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited: "Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77) .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏من خلف على مال امرئ مسلم بغير حقه، لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان‏" ‏ قال‏:‏ ثم قرأ علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مصداقه من كتاب الله عز وجل‏:‏ ‏{‏إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنًا قليلا‏}‏ ‏(‏‏(‏آل عمران‏:‏ 77‏)‏‏)‏ إلى آخر الآية‏:‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased
entries.excerpt: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim...
entries.hadithText: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree." .
entries.englishText: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي أُمامة إياس بن ثعلبة الحارثي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏من اقتطع حق امرئ مسلم بيمينه، فقد أوجب الله له النار‏.‏ -وحرم عليه الجنة‏"‏ فقال له رجل‏:‏ وإن كان شيئًا يسيرًا يا رسول الله‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏وإن كان قضيبًا من أراك‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said

entries.title: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with
entries.excerpt: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah,...
entries.hadithText: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally)." . Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."
entries.englishText: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally)." . Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He (ﷺ) replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."
entries.arabicText: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏الكبائر‏:‏ الإشراك بالله، وعقوق الوالدين، وقتل النفس، واليمين الغموس‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ وفي رواية‏:‏ أن أعرابيًا جاء إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال‏:‏ يا رسول الله ما الكبائر‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏الإشراك بالله‏ ‏ قال‏:‏ ثم ماذا‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏اليمين الغموس‏ ‏ قلت‏:‏ وما اليمين الغموس‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏ ‏الذي يقتطع مال امرئ مسلم‏ ‏ يعني بيمين هو فيها كاذب
entries.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to...
entries.hadithText: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative." .
entries.englishText: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative." .
entries.arabicText: عن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏وإذا حلفت على يمين، فرأيت غيرها خيرًا منها، فائت الذي هو خير، وكفر عن يمينك‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it,...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏من حلف على يمين، فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها، فليكفر عن يمينه، وليفعل الذي هو خير‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something...
entries.hadithText: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better." .
entries.englishText: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إني والله إن شاء الله لا أحلف على يمين، ثم أرى خيرًا منها إلا كفرت عن يميني، وأتيت الذي هو خير‏" ‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏
entries.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏"‏لأن يلج أحدكم في يمينه في أهله آثم له عند الله تعالى من أن يعطي كفارته التي فرض الله عليه‏"‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏ قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏يلَجّ‏"‏ بفتح اللام، وتشديد الجيم‏:‏ أي يتمادى فيها، ولا يكفر، قوله‏:‏ ‏"‏آثم‏"‏ هو بالثاء المثلثة، أي‏:‏ أكثر إثمًا‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Ayah
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect o...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect of those persons who are in the habit of repeating: 'No, by Allah'; and 'Yes, by Allah.' .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect of those persons who are in the habit of repeating: 'No, by Allah'; and 'Yes, by Allah.' .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ أنزلت هذه الآية‏:‏ ‏{‏لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم‏}‏ في قول الرجل‏:‏ لا والله، وبلى والله‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏الحلف منفقة للسلعة، ممحقة للكسب‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I
entries.excerpt: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote tr...
entries.hadithText: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing." .
entries.englishText: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing." .
entries.arabicText: عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏إياكم وكثرة الحلف في البيع، فإنه ينفق ثم يمحق‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings)." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إن أخنع اسم عند الله عز وجل رجل تسمى ملك الأملاك‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ قال سُفيانُ بن عُيَيْنَةَ: «مَلِكُ الأَمْلاَكِ» مِثْلُ: شَاهِن شَاهِ.
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or...
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron." .
entries.arabicText: عن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم دخل على أم السائب، أو أم المسيب فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏مالك يا أم السائب -أو يا أم المسيب- تزفزفين‏؟‏ ‏"‏ قالت‏:‏ الحمى لا بارك الله فيها، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏لا تسبي الحمى، فإنها تذهب خطايا بني آدم، كما يذهب الكير خبث الحديد‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ «تُزَفْزِفِينَ» أيْ تَتَحَرَّكِينَ حَرَكَةً سَريعَةً، وَمَعْنَاهُ: تَرْتَعِدِين. وَهُوَ بِضَمِّ التاء وبالزاي المكررة والفاء المكررة، وَرُوِيَ أيضًا بالراء المكررة والقافينِ.
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him)
entries.excerpt: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abo...
entries.hadithText: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded)." .
entries.englishText: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded)." .
entries.arabicText: عن أبي المنذر أبي بن كعب رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا تسبوا الريح، فإذا رأيتم ما تكرهون، فقولوا‏:‏ اللهم إنا نسألك من خير هذه الريح وخير ما فيها وخير ما أُمرت به، ونعوذ بك من شر هذه الريح وشر ما فيها وشر ما أُمرت به‏" ‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح‏)‏‏)‏
entries.narrator: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Whenever the
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fih...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent)." .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت‏:‏ كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا عصفت الريح قال‏:‏ اللهم إني أسألك خيرها، وخير ما فيها، وخير ما أُرسلت به، وأعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما أُرسلت به‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.excerpt: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At...
entries.hadithText: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."' .
entries.englishText: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."' .
entries.arabicText: عن زيد بن خالد رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ صلى بنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة الصبح بالحديبية في أثر سماء كانت من الليل، فلما انصرف أقبل على الناس، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏هل تدرون ماذا قال ربكم‏؟‏ ‏"‏ قالوا‏:‏ الله ورسوله أعلم‏.‏ قال‏:‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏أصبح من عبادي مؤمن بي وكافر بي ، فأما من قال‏:‏ مُطِرْنَا بفضل الله ورحمته، فذلك مؤمن بي كافر بالكواكب، وأما من قال‏:‏ مُطِرْنَا بنوء كذا وكذا، فذلك كافر بي مؤمن بالكواكب‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ والسماء هنا‏:‏ المطر‏‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him." .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏إذا قال رجل لأخيه‏:‏ يا كافر، فقد باء بها أحدهما، فإن كان كما قال وإلا رجعت عليه‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I
entries.excerpt: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody accuses another of disbelief or calls him the enemy o...
entries.hadithText: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody accuses another of disbelief or calls him the enemy of Allah, such an accusation will revert to him (the accuser) if the accused is innocent." .
entries.englishText: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If somebody accuses another of disbelief or calls him the enemy of Allah, such an accusation will revert to him (the accuser) if the accused is innocent." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏من دعا رجلا بالكفر، أو قال‏:‏ عدو الله، وليس كذلك إلا حار عليه‏" ‏ ‏(‏‏(‏متفق عليه‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏ حار‏ ‏ رجع‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently." .
entries.hadithText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently." .
entries.englishText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently." .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏ليس المؤمن بالطعان، ولا اللعان، ولا الفاحش، ولا البذي‏" ‏‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Indecency does not leave anything untainted and decency does not leave anything...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Indecency does not leave anything untainted and decency does not leave anything ungraced and embellished." .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Indecency does not leave anything untainted and decency does not leave anything ungraced and embellished." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏ما كان الفحش في شيء إلا شانه، وما كان الحياء في شيء إلا زانه‏" ‏‏.‏‏(‏‏(‏رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions

entries.title: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ruined are Al-Mutanatti'un." He repeated this thrice. .
entries.hadithText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ruined are Al-Mutanatti'un." He repeated this thrice. .
entries.englishText: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ruined are Al-Mutanatti'un." He repeated this thrice. .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏هلك المتنطعون‏"‏، قالها ثلاثًا‏.‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏.‏‏"‏المتنطعون‏"‏‏:‏ المبالغون في الأمور‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏
entries.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book of the Prohibited actions
