entries.excerpt: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I do not eat reclining (against a pillow)." .
entries.hadithText: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I do not eat reclining (against a pillow)." .
entries.englishText: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "I do not eat reclining (against a pillow)." .
entries.arabicText: عن أبى جحيفة وهب بن عبد الله رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم‏:‏ ‏ "‏ لا آكل متكئاً‏" ‏.‏‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating some dates while sitting on his buttocks, with his legs raised. .
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating some dates while sitting on his buttocks, with his legs raised. .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating some dates while sitting on his buttocks, with his legs raised. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم جالساً مقعياً يأكل تمراً.‏ ‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you finishes eating, he should not wipe his fingers until he...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you finishes eating, he should not wipe his fingers until he has licked them himself or has given them to someone else to lick for him." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When one of you finishes eating, he should not wipe his fingers until he has licked them himself or has given them to someone else to lick for him." .
entries.arabicText: عن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم‏:‏ ‏ "‏إذا أكل أحدكم طعاماً، فلا يمسح أصابعه حتى يلعقها أو يلعقها‏" ‏‏.‏ ‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating with three fingers (i.e., the thumb, the index finger and the mi...
entries.hadithText: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating with three fingers (i.e., the thumb, the index finger and the middle finger) and licking them after having finished the food. .
entries.englishText: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) eating with three fingers (i.e., the thumb, the index finger and the middle finger) and licking them after having finished the food. .
entries.arabicText: وعن كعب بن مالك رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يأكل بثلاث أصابع ، فإذا فرغ لعقها‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏ ‏
entries.narrator: Ka'b bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded the licking of fingers and the gleaning of the dish, saying, "You do not know in which portion the blessing lies." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded the licking of fingers and the gleaning of the dish, saying, "You do not know in which portion the blessing lies." .
entries.arabicText: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أمر بلعق الأصابع والصحفة، وقال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إنكم لا تدرون في أي طعامكم البركة‏" ‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a morsel of any of you falls, he should pick it up and remove any of t...
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a morsel of any of you falls, he should pick it up and remove any of the dirt on it and then eat it, and should not leave it for Satan nor should wipe his hand with towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a morsel of any of you falls, he should pick it up and remove any of the dirt on it and then eat it, and should not leave it for Satan nor should wipe his hand with towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies." .
entries.arabicText: وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إذا وقعت لقمة أحدكم، فليأخذها فليمط ما كان بها من أذى وليأكلها، ولا يدعها للشيطان، ولا يمسح يده بالمنديل حتى يلعق أصابعه؛ فإنه لا يدرى في أي طعامه البركة‏" ‏ .‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏ ‏
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Satan appears at every thing done by you; he appears even at one's dinner....
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Satan appears at every thing done by you; he appears even at one's dinner. When a morsel of any of you falls, he should pick it up and remove any dirt on it, and then eat it. He should not leave it for Satan, nor should he wipe his hand with the towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Satan appears at every thing done by you; he appears even at one's dinner. When a morsel of any of you falls, he should pick it up and remove any dirt on it, and then eat it. He should not leave it for Satan, nor should he wipe his hand with the towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies." .
entries.arabicText: وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏إن الشيطان يحضر أحدكم عند كل شئ من شأنه، حتى يحضره عند طعامه؛ فإذا سقطت لقمة أحدكم فليأخذها فليمط ما كان بها من أذى، ثم ليأكلها ولا يدعها للشيطان، فإذا فرغ فليلعق أصابعه؛ فإنه لا يدرى في أي طعامه البركة‏" ‏‏‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ate food, he would lick his three fingers and say, "If anyone of you drops...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ate food, he would lick his three fingers and say, "If anyone of you drops a morsel of food, he should remove any dirt that may have stuck on it and then eat it, and should not leave it for Satan." He (ﷺ) also commanded us that we should glean the pot, saying, "You do not know in which part of your food the blessings lies." .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ate food, he would lick his three fingers and say, "If anyone of you drops a morsel of food, he should remove any dirt that may have stuck on it and then eat it, and should not leave it for Satan." He (ﷺ) also commanded us that we should glean the pot, saying, "You do not know in which part of your food the blessings lies." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أكل طعاماً، لعق أصابعه الثلاث، وقال‏:‏‏"‏إذا سقطت لقمة أحدكم فليأخذها، وليمط عنها الأذى، وليأكلها،ولا يدعها للشيطان‏"‏ وأمرنا أن نسلت القصعة وقال‏:‏ ‏"‏إنكم لا تدرون في أي طعامكم البركة‏"‏ ‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Sa'id bin Al-Harith reported: I asked Jabir (May Allah be
entries.excerpt: Sa'id bin Al-Harith reported: I asked Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) whether it was obligatory to make Wudu' for Salat (prayer) after eating cooked fo...
entries.hadithText: Sa'id bin Al-Harith reported: I asked Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) whether it was obligatory to make Wudu' for Salat (prayer) after eating cooked food. He said: "No, because in the lifetime of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), such food was rarely available. We had no handkerchiefs, so when we ate such food we would wipe our fingers against our palms, forearms or (the sole of our) feet, and would offer Salat without fresh Wudu' (for prayer)." .
entries.englishText: Sa'id bin Al-Harith reported: I asked Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) whether it was obligatory to make Wudu' for Salat (prayer) after eating cooked food. He said: "No, because in the lifetime of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), such food was rarely available. We had no handkerchiefs, so when we ate such food we would wipe our fingers against our palms, forearms or (the sole of our) feet, and would offer Salat without fresh Wudu' (for prayer)." .
entries.arabicText: وعن سعيد بن الحارث أنه سأل جابراً رضى الله عنه عن الوضوء مما مست النار، فقال‏:‏ لا ، قد كنا زمن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لا نجد مثل ذلك الطعام إلا قليلاً، فإذا نحن وجدناه، لم يكن لنا مناديل إلا أكفنا وسواعدنا وأقدامنا، ثم نصلى ولا نتوضأ‏.‏ ‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: Sa'id bin Al-Harith reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of two persons suffices for three persons, and the food of...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of two persons suffices for three persons, and the food of three persons suffices for four persons." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of two persons suffices for three persons, and the food of three persons suffices for four persons." .
entries.arabicText: عن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال ‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏طعام الاثنين كافي الثلاثة، وطعام الثلاثة كافي الأربعة‏"‏.‏ ((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of one person suffices for two, the food of two pers...
entries.hadithText: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of one person suffices for two, the food of two persons suffices for four persons, and the food of four persons suffices for eight persons." .
entries.englishText: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The food of one person suffices for two, the food of two persons suffices for four persons, and the food of four persons suffices for eight persons." .
entries.arabicText: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏ "‏طعام الواحد يكفى الاثنين، وطعام الاثنين يكفى الأربعة، وطعام الأربعة يكفى الثمانية‏" ‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to breathe three times in the course of a drink (he used to drink in three gul...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to breathe three times in the course of a drink (he used to drink in three gulps). .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to breathe three times in the course of a drink (he used to drink in three gulps). .
entries.arabicText: عن أنس رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يتنفس في الشراب ثلاثاً‏.‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade breathing into the vessel while drinking. .
entries.hadithText: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade breathing into the vessel while drinking. .
entries.englishText: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade breathing into the vessel while drinking. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى قتادة رضى الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أن يتنفس في الإناء‏.‏‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Milk mixed
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Milk mixed with water was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). On his right side was sitting a bedouin and o...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Milk mixed with water was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). On his right side was sitting a bedouin and on his left was sitting Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him). He (ﷺ) drank from it and handed the rest to the bedouin saying, "One who is on the right has preference, then again the one who is on the right." .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Milk mixed with water was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). On his right side was sitting a bedouin and on his left was sitting Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him). He (ﷺ) drank from it and handed the rest to the bedouin saying, "One who is on the right has preference, then again the one who is on the right." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أتى بلبن قد شيب بماء، وعن يمينه أعرابي، وعن يساره أبو بكر رضى الله عنه ، فشرب، ثم أعطى الأعرابي وقال‏:‏ ‏ "‏الأيمن فالأيمن‏" ‏.((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A drink was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he drank (some) from it. On his right was a boy...
entries.hadithText: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A drink was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he drank (some) from it. On his right was a boy and on his left were some elderly people. He (ﷺ) said to the boy, "Would you permit me to give rest of this drink to these on my left?" The boy said: "O Messenger of Allah, I would certainly not give preference to anyone in anything that might come to me from you." So he (ﷺ) handed over the rest of the drink to him. .
entries.englishText: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A drink was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he drank (some) from it. On his right was a boy and on his left were some elderly people. He (ﷺ) said to the boy, "Would you permit me to give rest of this drink to these on my left?" The boy said: "O Messenger of Allah, I would certainly not give preference to anyone in anything that might come to me from you." So he (ﷺ) handed over the rest of the drink to him. .
entries.arabicText: وعن سهل بن سعد رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أتى بشراب، فشرب منه وعن يمينه غلام، وعن يساره أشياخ، فقال للغلام‏:‏ ‏ "‏أتأذن لي أن أعطى هؤلاء‏.‏‏؟‏‏" ‏ فقال الغلام‏:‏ لا والله ، لا أوثر بنصيبي منك أحدا، فتله رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في يده‏.‏((متفق عليه)) ‏
entries.narrator: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.excerpt: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade turning the water-skin upside down and drinking directly fro...
entries.hadithText: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade turning the water-skin upside down and drinking directly from its mouth. .
entries.englishText: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade turning the water-skin upside down and drinking directly from its mouth. .
entries.arabicText: عن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه قال ‏:‏ نهى رسول الله عن اختناث الأسقية ‏:‏ يعنى‏:‏ أن تكسر أفواهها، ويشرب منها‏.‏((متفق عليه))

entries.arabicText: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يشرب من في السقاء أو القربة.‏((متفق عليه))

entries.title: Umm Thabit Kabshah (May Allah be pleased with her), daughter
entries.excerpt: Umm Thabit Kabshah (May Allah be pleased with her), daughter of Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him) and the sister of Hassan bin Thabit, the Prophet's poe...
entries.hadithText: Umm Thabit Kabshah (May Allah be pleased with her), daughter of Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him) and the sister of Hassan bin Thabit, the Prophet's poet) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me and drank some water from a hanging water-skin while he was in a standing posture. So, I stood up and cut off the mouth (of that water-skin). . An-Nawawi said that the reason why she did this was to preserve the part of the water-skin which the lips of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) touched, gain blessings from it, and preserve it from dishonor. This narration is understood to show permissibility whereas the previous two narrations are to show what is better and closer to perfection. Allah knows best.
entries.englishText: Umm Thabit Kabshah (May Allah be pleased with her), daughter of Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him) and the sister of Hassan bin Thabit, the Prophet's poet) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited me and drank some water from a hanging water-skin while he was in a standing posture. So, I stood up and cut off the mouth (of that water-skin). . An-Nawawi said that the reason why she did this was to preserve the part of the water-skin which the lips of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) touched, gain blessings from it, and preserve it from dishonor. This narration is understood to show permissibility whereas the previous two narrations are to show what is better and closer to perfection. Allah knows best.
entries.arabicText: وعن أم ثابت كبشة بنت ثابت أخت حسان بن ثابت رضى الله عنه وعنها قالت‏:‏ دخل عليَّ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فشرب من فيّ قربة معلقة قائماً، فقمت إلى فيها فقطعته‏ ‏((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)). وإنما قطعتها لتحفظ موضع فم رَسُول اللَّهِ ﷺ وتتبرك به وتصونه عن الابتذال. وهذا الحديث محمول على بيان الجواز، والحديثان السابقان لبيان الأفضل والأكمل، والله أعلم.
entries.narrator: Umm Thabit Kabshah (May Allah be pleased with her), daughter of Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him) and the sister of Hassan bin Thabit, the Prophet's poet) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: I served the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) Zamzam water to drink and he drank it while he was standing. .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: I served the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) Zamzam water to drink and he drank it while he was standing. .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما قال‏:‏ سقيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من زمزم، فشرب وهو قائم ‏.‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: An-Nazzal bin Sabrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: An-Nazzal bin Sabrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) arrived at Bab Ar-Rahbah (in Kufah) and dra...
entries.hadithText: An-Nazzal bin Sabrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) arrived at Bab Ar-Rahbah (in Kufah) and drank water in a standing posture. Then he said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing what you have seen me doing." .
entries.englishText: An-Nazzal bin Sabrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) arrived at Bab Ar-Rahbah (in Kufah) and drank water in a standing posture. Then he said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing what you have seen me doing." .
entries.arabicText: وعن النزال بن سبرة رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ أتى علي رضى الله عنه باب الرحبة فشرب قائماً، وقال‏:‏ إني رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فعل كما رأيتموني فعلت‏.‏‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: An-Nazzal bin Sabrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet
entries.excerpt: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us from drinking while standing. Qatadah reported: "We asked him: 'What about eating?"...
entries.hadithText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us from drinking while standing. Qatadah reported: "We asked him: 'What about eating?"' He said: "That is even worse, (or may be he said) more detestable." Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reprimanded [us] for drinking while standing. .
entries.englishText: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade us from drinking while standing. Qatadah reported: "We asked him: 'What about eating?"' He said: "That is even worse, (or may be he said) more detestable." Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reprimanded [us] for drinking while standing. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أنس رضى الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه نهى أن يشرب الرجل قائماً‏.‏ قال قتادة‏:‏ فقلنا لأنس‏:‏ فالأكل‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ذلك أشر -أو أخبث- ‏.‏ وفى رواية له أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم زجر عن الشرب قائما.‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏ وفى رواية له أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم زجر عن الشرب قائماً‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should drink standing; and if any one forgets, he must v...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should drink standing; and if any one forgets, he must vomit." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "None of you should drink standing; and if any one forgets, he must vomit." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ لا يشربن أحد منكم قائماً، فمن نسى فليستقئ‏"‏‏‏‏. ((رواه مسلم))‏

entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Once the time for As-Salat (the prayer) approached. Those whose houses were near, went to their hous...
entries.hadithText: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Once the time for As-Salat (the prayer) approached. Those whose houses were near, went to their houses (to perform Wudu') while some of the people remained with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). A stone (containing some water) bowl was brought for him. It was too small for him to spread his hand over it. He performed his Wudu' and it (the water) sufficed for all the others also. Anas was asked: "How many of you were present there?" He said: "Eighty or more." This is Al-Bukhari's version. In Muslim's version "'that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for a container of water so he was given a vessel that had some water.' Anas said 'Then I started looking at the water spouting from his fingers. Then I estimated (the persons) and they were between seventy and eighty.'"
entries.englishText: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Once the time for As-Salat (the prayer) approached. Those whose houses were near, went to their houses (to perform Wudu') while some of the people remained with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). A stone (containing some water) bowl was brought for him. It was too small for him to spread his hand over it. He performed his Wudu' and it (the water) sufficed for all the others also. Anas was asked: "How many of you were present there?" He said: "Eighty or more." This is Al-Bukhari's version. In Muslim's version "'that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for a container of water so he was given a vessel that had some water.' Anas said 'Then I started looking at the water spouting from his fingers. Then I estimated (the persons) and they were between seventy and eighty.'"
entries.arabicText: عن أنس رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ حضرت الصلاة، فقام من كان قريب الدار إلى أهله، وبقى قوم فأتى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بمخضب من حجارة، فصغر المخضب أن يبسط فيه كفه، فتوضأ القوم كلهم‏.‏ قالوا‏:‏ كم كنتم‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ثمانين وزيادة‏.‏((متفق عليه))، هذه رواية البخاري. وفي رواية مسلم:‏ أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم دعا بإناء من ماء، فأتى بقدح رحراح فيه شئ من ماء، فوضع أصابعه فيه‏.‏ قال أنس ‏:‏ فجعلت أنظر إلى الماء ينبع من بين أصابعه ‎، فحزرت من توضأ ما بين السبعين إلى الثمانين‏.‏
entries.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited the house of a man of the Ansar with one of his Companions and said to him...
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited the house of a man of the Ansar with one of his Companions and said to him, "If you have some water in the water-skin left over from last night, give it to us for drinking; otherwise, we shall drink from some stream directly." .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) visited the house of a man of the Ansar with one of his Companions and said to him, "If you have some water in the water-skin left over from last night, give it to us for drinking; otherwise, we shall drink from some stream directly." .
entries.arabicText: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم دخل على رجل من الأنصار، ومعه صاحب له، فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم‏:‏ ‏ "‏إن كان عندك ماء بات هذه الليلة في سنة وإلا كرعنا‏" ‏‏‏.‏‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.hadithText: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited us from wearing brocade or silk and drinking out of gold or silver vessels and said, "These are meant for them (disbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter." .
entries.englishText: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited us from wearing brocade or silk and drinking out of gold or silver vessels and said, "These are meant for them (disbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter." .
entries.arabicText: وعن حذيفة رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ إن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهانا عن الحرير والديباج والشرب في آنية الذهب والفضة، وقال‏:‏ ‏ "‏هي لهم في الدنيا، وهى لكم في الآخرة‏" ‏‏.((متفق عليه)) ‏
entries.narrator: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who drinks from the vessel of silver kindles the Fire (of Hell) in...
entries.hadithText: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who drinks from the vessel of silver kindles the Fire (of Hell) in his belly." . A narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Surely, he who eats or drinks in gold and silver vessels fills his belly with Hell-fire."
entries.englishText: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who drinks from the vessel of silver kindles the Fire (of Hell) in his belly." . A narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Surely, he who eats or drinks in gold and silver vessels fills his belly with Hell-fire."
entries.arabicText: وعن أم سلمة رضى الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏الذي يشرب في آنية الفضة إنما يجرجر في بطنه نار جهنم‏"‏‏.((متفق عليه)) ‏ وفى ‏:‏ ‏"‏إن الذي يأكل أو يشرب في آنية الفضة والذهب‏"‏ وفى رواية له‏:‏ ‏"‏ من شرب في إناءٍ من ذهب أو فضة فإنما يجرجر في بطنه ناراً من جهنم‏.‏
entries.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported
entries.sourceChapterTitle: The Book About the Etiquette of Eating

entries.title: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of
entries.excerpt: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was of medium stature. I saw him wearing a red mantle. I have never seen anything more...
entries.hadithText: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was of medium stature. I saw him wearing a red mantle. I have never seen anything more graceful than that. .
entries.englishText: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was of medium stature. I saw him wearing a red mantle. I have never seen anything more graceful than that. .
entries.arabicText: وعن البراء رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مربوعاً، ولقد رأيته في حلةٍ حمراء ما رأيت شيئاً قط أحسن منه.((متفق عليه)) ‏‏
entries.narrator: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with
entries.excerpt: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) by Al-Abtah valley in Makkah, in a red tent made from tanned...
entries.hadithText: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) by Al-Abtah valley in Makkah, in a red tent made from tanned skin. Bilal brought him ablution water. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out wearing a red mantle; and I can still remember looking at whiteness of his shanks. So he made his ablution, and Bilal (ﷺ) pronounced the call for prayer (Adhan). I kept following the movement of his (Bilal's) face to the right and to the left when he recited: 'Come to the prayer; come to the success.' Then a spear was fixed (as a Sutrah) in front of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who then stepped forward and led the prayer. Dogs and donkeys passed in front of him (beyond the spear) and no one prevented them from doing so. .
entries.englishText: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) by Al-Abtah valley in Makkah, in a red tent made from tanned skin. Bilal brought him ablution water. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out wearing a red mantle; and I can still remember looking at whiteness of his shanks. So he made his ablution, and Bilal (ﷺ) pronounced the call for prayer (Adhan). I kept following the movement of his (Bilal's) face to the right and to the left when he recited: 'Come to the prayer; come to the success.' Then a spear was fixed (as a Sutrah) in front of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who then stepped forward and led the prayer. Dogs and donkeys passed in front of him (beyond the spear) and no one prevented them from doing so. .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى جحيفة وهب بن عبد الله رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بمكة وهو بالأبطح في قبة له حمراء من آدم، فخرج بلال بوضوئه، فمن ناضح ونائل، فخرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه حلة حمراء، كأني أنظر إلى بياض ساقيه، فتوضأ وأذن بلال، فجعلت أتتبع فاه ههنا وههنا، يقول يمينا وشمالاً‏:‏ حي على الصلاة، حي على الفلاح، ثم ركزت له عنزة، فتقدم فصلى يمر بين يديه الكلب والحمار لا يمنع‏.((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger
entries.excerpt: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered Makkah on the day of its conquest and he was wearing a black turban. .
entries.hadithText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered Makkah on the day of its conquest and he was wearing a black turban. .
entries.englishText: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered Makkah on the day of its conquest and he was wearing a black turban. .
entries.arabicText: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه ، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم دخل يوم فتح مكة وعليه عمامة سوداء‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with
entries.excerpt: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: It was as if I am seeing the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing a black turban and both ends...
entries.hadithText: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: It was as if I am seeing the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing a black turban and both ends of it are falling over his shoulders. . Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering a Khutbah wearing a black turban.
entries.englishText: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: It was as if I am seeing the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wearing a black turban and both ends of it are falling over his shoulders. . Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering a Khutbah wearing a black turban.
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى سعيد عمرو بن حريث رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ كأني انظر إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه عمامة سوداء، قد أرخى طرفيها بين كتفيه‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏ ‏ وفى رواية له ‏:‏ أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم خطب الناس، وعليه عمامة سوداء‏.
entries.narrator: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The body
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The body of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton garments, among which was neit...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The body of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton garments, among which was neither a gown nor a turban. .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: The body of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton garments, among which was neither a gown nor a turban. .
entries.arabicText: وعن عائشة رضى الله عنها قالت‏:‏ كفن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في ثلاثة أثواب بيض سحولية من كرسف، ليس فيها قميص ولا عمامة‏.((متفق عليه)) ‏ ‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported

entries.title: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: One morning
entries.excerpt: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: One morning the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out wearing a black blanket made of a camel or sheep's black ha...
entries.hadithText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: One morning the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out wearing a black blanket made of a camel or sheep's black hair with patterns of camel's bags upon it. .
entries.englishText: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: One morning the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out wearing a black blanket made of a camel or sheep's black hair with patterns of camel's bags upon it. .
entries.arabicText: وعنها قالت‏:‏ خرج رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات غداة، وعليه مرط مرحل من شعر أسود‏.‏‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported

entries.title: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey one night, and he asked me, "Do you have...
entries.hadithText: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey one night, and he asked me, "Do you have any water with you?" I said, "Yes." So he dismounted from his riding camel and walked away (to answer the call of nature) until he disappeared in the darkness. When he returned, I poured out some water from a vessel and he washed his face. He was wearing a long woolen cloak and could not take out his forearms from his sleeves, so he brought them out from below the cloak and then washed them, and then passed his (wet) hands over his head. I stretched out my hand to take off his Khuff (leather socks), but he said, "Leave them. I put them on after performing Wudu'," and he passed his (wet) hands over them. . Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wearing a Syrian cloak with tight sleeves. Another narration is: This incident took place during the battle of Tabuk.
entries.englishText: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey one night, and he asked me, "Do you have any water with you?" I said, "Yes." So he dismounted from his riding camel and walked away (to answer the call of nature) until he disappeared in the darkness. When he returned, I poured out some water from a vessel and he washed his face. He was wearing a long woolen cloak and could not take out his forearms from his sleeves, so he brought them out from below the cloak and then washed them, and then passed his (wet) hands over his head. I stretched out my hand to take off his Khuff (leather socks), but he said, "Leave them. I put them on after performing Wudu'," and he passed his (wet) hands over them. . Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wearing a Syrian cloak with tight sleeves. Another narration is: This incident took place during the battle of Tabuk.
entries.arabicText: وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ كنت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات ليلة في مسير، فقال لي‏:‏ ‏"‏أمعك ماء‏"‏ ‏؟‏ قلت‏:‏ نعم، فنزل عن راحلته فمشى حتى توارى في سواد الليل ثم جاء فأفرغت علي من الإداواة، فغسل وجهه وعليه جبة من صوف،فلم يستطع أن يخرج ذراعيه منها حتى أخرجهما من أسفل الجبة، فغسل ذراعيه ومسح برأسه، ثم أهويت لأنزع خفيه فقال‏:‏‏"‏دعهما فإني أدخلتهما طاهرتين‏"‏ ومسح عليهما‏.‏((متفق عليه)) وفى رواية‏:‏وعليه جبة شامية ضيقة الكمين‏.‏ وفى رواية‏:‏ أن هذه القضية كانت في غزوة تبوك‏.‏
entries.narrator: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever allows his lower garment to drag out of vanity will find that Allah will n...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever allows his lower garment to drag out of vanity will find that Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection." On this Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) replied: "O Messenger of Allah! My lower garment keeps sliding down though I take care to pull it and wrap it." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "You are not of those who do it out of vanity." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever allows his lower garment to drag out of vanity will find that Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection." On this Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) replied: "O Messenger of Allah! My lower garment keeps sliding down though I take care to pull it and wrap it." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "You are not of those who do it out of vanity." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏من جر ثوبه خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة‏"‏ فقال أبو بكر‏:‏ يا رسول الله إن إزاري يسترخي إلى أن أتعاهده، فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم‏:‏ ‏"‏إنك لست ممن يفعله خيلاء‏"‏‏.‏‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails hi...
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏لا ينظر الله يوم القيامة إلى من جر إزاره بطراً‏" ‏.‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The
entries.excerpt: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is below the ankles of a lower garment is condemned to the Fire (Hell)." .
entries.hadithText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is below the ankles of a lower garment is condemned to the Fire (Hell)." .
entries.englishText: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is below the ankles of a lower garment is condemned to the Fire (Hell)." .
entries.arabicText: وعنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏ "‏ما أسفل من الكعبين من الإزار ففي النار‏" ‏.‏‏‏((‏رواه البخارى‏)‏‏)‏‏
entries.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I
entries.excerpt: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There are three to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrect...
entries.hadithText: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There are three to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will look at them nor purify them (i.e., of their sins), and they will be severely tormented." When he repeated this (statement) thrice, Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "They are doomed and destroyed! (But) who are they, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?" He said, "One whose lower garment trails, one who boasts of kindness shown to another; and one who promotes sale of his business by taking false oaths." .
entries.englishText: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There are three to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will look at them nor purify them (i.e., of their sins), and they will be severely tormented." When he repeated this (statement) thrice, Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "They are doomed and destroyed! (But) who are they, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?" He said, "One whose lower garment trails, one who boasts of kindness shown to another; and one who promotes sale of his business by taking false oaths." .
entries.arabicText: وعن أبى ذر رضى الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة، ولا ينظر إليهم ، ولا يزكيهم، ولهم عذاب أليم‏"‏ قال‏:‏ فقرأها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثلاث مرار‏.‏ قال أبو ذر ‏:‏ خابوا وخسروا ‍ من هم يا رسول الله ‏؟‏ قال‏:‏ ‏"‏المسبل، والمنان، والمنفق سلعته بالحلف الكاذب‏"‏‏‏‏.‏ وفى رواية له‏:‏ ‏"‏المسبل إزاره‏"‏‏‏.((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: My
entries.excerpt: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: My lower garment was trailing as I passed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) so he said, "Raise your lower ga...
entries.hadithText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: My lower garment was trailing as I passed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) so he said, "Raise your lower garment, Abdullah." I lifted it up and he told me to raise it higher. I complied with his orders and as I was still trying to find the best place (for it), one of the people asked where it should reach and he (ﷺ) replied, "Half way down the knees." .
entries.englishText: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: My lower garment was trailing as I passed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) so he said, "Raise your lower garment, Abdullah." I lifted it up and he told me to raise it higher. I complied with his orders and as I was still trying to find the best place (for it), one of the people asked where it should reach and he (ﷺ) replied, "Half way down the knees." .
entries.arabicText: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما قال‏:‏ مررت على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وفى إزاري استرخاء، فقال‏:‏ ‏"‏يا عبد الله، ارفع إزارك‏"‏ فرفعت ثم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏زد‏"‏، فزدت، فما زلت أتحراها بعد‏.‏ فقال بعض القوم‏:‏ إلى أين ‏؟‏ فقال‏:‏ إلى أنصاف الساقين‏"‏‏.‏‏((رواه مسلم))‏
entries.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported

entries.title: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not wear silk (clothes). For whoever wears (them) in this...
entries.hadithText: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not wear silk (clothes). For whoever wears (them) in this life will be deprived of them in the Hereafter." .
entries.englishText: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not wear silk (clothes). For whoever wears (them) in this life will be deprived of them in the Hereafter." .
entries.arabicText: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضى الله عنه قال‏:‏ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏:‏ ‏ "‏ لا تلبسوا الحرير؛ فإن من لبسه في الدنيا لم يلبسه في الآخرة‏" ‏ ‏.‏((متفق عليه))
entries.narrator: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported

entries.title: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
entries.excerpt: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Silk (clothes) are worn only by he who has no shar...
entries.hadithText: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Silk (clothes) are worn only by he who has no share in the Hereafter." . Another narration is: "Who has no share in the Hereafter."
entries.englishText: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Silk (clothes) are worn only by he who has no share in the Hereafter." . Another narration is: "Who has no share in the Hereafter."
entries.arabicText: وعنه قال‏:‏ سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول‏:‏ ‏"‏إنما يلبس الحرير من لا خلاق له‏"‏.((متفق عليه)) ‏ وفى رواية للبخاري‏:‏ ‏"‏من لا خلاق له في الآخرة‏"‏‏
entries.narrator: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported
